svg.title: The heater's answer to a sine at 0.2 radians per second
svg.desc: After the start-up, which is left out of the measurement, a 5 percentage point sine at 0.2 radians per second moves the water by 0.725 degrees Celsius each way, an amplitude ratio of 0.1416 degrees per point, and each temperature peak comes about 5 seconds after the command's peak.
svg.text: The heater's answer to a 5-point sine at 0.2 rad/s
Control Studio recording of this project · heater control off · numbers answer the predictions
Time after the start of the sine (s)
Peak 5.1 s after the command's (predicted 4.93 s)
Half swing 0.725 °C for 5 points: M = 0.1416 °C per point
